verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken skeleton. The missing partner-mark placeholder is blown up to fill the right third, the RSVP CTA is shrunk to badge size and sits inline with the pills so it gets buried, and the legal copy is tiny. A also loses the Solstice sun icon and crams 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' tiny above the logo. B keeps the logo with its icon and uses a slightly smaller placeholder, but strands 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' on the far right, away from the headline.
